claim_boundary: Diagnostic source-labelled memory attribution only; no compression, runtime, or memory-eligibility authority.
activation_dependencies: Arm B is terminal and its complete evidence is frozen
allocation-marker source integration is reviewed, hashed, and compiled
instrumented and uninstrumented small-scope probability identity passes
resource guard v3, marker parser, page-state capture, and all offline verifiers are source-locked
codec command, input, scratch, environment, and result paths are frozen
preflight: fail if exclusive_full1g.json or its acquisition lock exists
fail if result or scratch directory is nonempty
verify runner, codec, contract, source-integration, compiler, command, input, and environment hashes
verify one logical CPU binding and process-tree memory ceiling 10000000000 bytes
create marker pipe and a separately fsynced marker-sequence state file
prepare but do not yet authorize the page-state capture path

transaction.operation: launch the instrumented codec through resource guard v3 with the marker write FD inherited
transaction.postcondition: runner owns the complete codec descendant tree and resource guard begins before model initialization

transaction.operation: bind codec PID, proc_start_ticks, and codec command SHA-256
transaction.postcondition: managed lease emits codec_activated and only then sets signal_authority=true
only complete contiguous 64-byte records update the active-allocation registry and fsynced marker-sequence file
every new process-tree RSS maximum and every phase transition enqueues one checkpoint request; no checkpoint runs concurrently

transaction.operation: materialize a live-allocation set at a drained marker boundary
transaction.postcondition: live set PID/start identity and marker sequence equal the managed lease and sequence state
codec tree resumes, maps and marker sequence remain stable, and a PFN-free double-read page-state manifest is retained

transaction.operation: continue codec and guard to terminal
transaction.postcondition: codec return code, marker EOF, guard terminal state, phase receipt, scratch, and cleanup evidence are frozen independently

transaction.operation: revoke signaling and release managed lease
transaction.postcondition: codec identity is no longer live, terminal lease is frozen, terminal transition is last, and runtime lease plus lock are removed
lease, marker, page-state, phase, guard, source integration, and attribution decisions are independently hashed
successor is null unless every authority predicate and conservative reclaimable lower-bound requirement passes

resource_contract.checkpoint_serialization: one stopped-process capture at a time
resource_contract.reason_runtime_authority_is_false: stopped-process pagemap checkpoints deliberately perturb execution

marker_contract.pipe_backpressure: terminal invalidity; marker writes may not be silently dropped
marker_contract.sequence_state_update: write temporary, fsync, atomic rename, fsync parent directory

failure_semantics.before_codec_launch: release a non-signaling lease only after preserving the failure receipt
failure_semantics.after_codec_launch: do not remove the managed lease while the bound codec identity remains live
failure_semantics.capture_failure: resume every pidfd-bound process, revoke signal authority, preserve partial evidence, and classify the attribution receipt invalid
failure_semantics.resource_failure: terminate through the resource guard, preserve marker and lease evidence, and grant no memory or compression verdict
failure_semantics.codec_failure: preserve return code, stdout, stderr, marker stream, scratch state, and all completed checkpoints
failure_semantics.verifier_failure: retain failed verification receipts and hashes; successor_authorized remains null
failure_semantics.cleanup_failure: preserve paths and allocated/logical byte counts; do not rewrite or rotate evidence

required_terminal_artifacts: each pair of page-state byte streams
stdout, stderr, command, environment, and cleanup receipts

immutability.change_after_launch: requires a new runner and candidate identifier
